nodes.description: Public address state variable holding the current contract owner in Owned.
Public address state variable holding the pending owner during two-step ownership transfer.

Total token supply state variable (100000000 * 10^18).
Mapping of token holder balances, written by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner => spender => amount.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance indexing and as spender/from in token operations.
Checked addition helper in SafeMath.
Checked subtraction helper in SafeMath.
Checked multiplication helper in SafeMath.
Checked division helper in SafeMath.
Owned constructor that sets owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function setting newOwner to the proposed address.
Second step of ownership transfer, requires msg.sender == newOwner, then promotes newOwner to owner.
Token constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals, mints full supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
Returns the balance of the given token owner.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub and safeAdd.
Sets the allowance of spender for msg.sender to tokens.
Moves tokens from `from` to `to` and decreases the caller allowance.
Returns remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
Approves spender then calls receiveApproval on the untrusted spender contract in one transaction.
Payable fallback that always reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner function that forwards an external ERC20 transfer of arbitrary tokens to the owner.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an attacker-controlled contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an owner-supplied token address.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner from the untrusted msg.sender, establishing the privilege anchor.
Constructor writes the caller address into the owner state variable.
Dancoin constructor implicitly invokes the Owned base constructor, setting owner to msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before allowing transferOwnership.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner guard of transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the proposed address into newOwner, pending acceptance.
_newOwner parameter flows into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal newOwner before promoting ownership.
acceptOwnership overwrites the owner state variable with newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
Constructor initializes the _totalSupply state variable.
Constructor mints the entire supply into balances of the fixed holder address.
Constructor sets the token symbol state variable.
Constructor sets the token name state variable.
Constructor sets the decimals state variable.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] as the burn adjustment.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction of a balance from _totalSupply, allowing underflow to a huge value.
balanceOf reads from the balances mapping.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
transfer uses msg.sender as the source account index in balances.
transfer writes updated balances for sender and recipient.
transfer reads balances[msg.sender] and balances[to] before updating.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
to parameter is the recipient index written in balances.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transfer.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], keyed by the caller.
approve writes the requested amount into the allowed mapping.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value stored by approve.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key in the allowed mapping.
transferFrom updates balances of the from and to accounts.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
from parameter indexes balances and allowed in transferFrom.
to parameter is the recipient balance index in transferFrom.
tokens parameter controls the moved amount in transferFrom.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
tokenOwner parameter is the outer key of the allowed lookup.
spender parameter is the inner key of the allowed lookup.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into the allowed mapping before the external call.
approveAndCall keys allowed by msg.sender and forwards msg.sender to the callee.
spender parameter is both the allowance key and the external call target.
tokens parameter is the approved amount forwarded to receiveApproval.
data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the untrusted callee.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on an attacker-controlled contract, enabling reentrant callbacks.
The spender parameter fully controls the target address of the external call.
msg.sender is passed as `from` into the untrusted receiveApproval callback.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by the onlyOwner check on msg.sender.
owner is read by the onlyOwner guard and used as the transfer recipient.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external transfer on an arbitrary token contract, restricted to the owner.
tokenAddress parameter selects the external contract that is called.
tokens parameter is the amount forwarded in the external transfer.
Parameter a is an operand of the safeAdd addition.
Parameter b is an operand of the safeAdd addition.
Local c receives the addition result and is returned by safeAdd.
Parameter a is an operand of the safeSub subtraction.
Parameter b is an operand of the safeSub subtraction.
Parameter a is an operand of the safeMul multiplication.
Parameter b is an operand of the safeMul multiplication.
Parameter a is the numerator of the safeDiv division.
Parameter b is the denominator of the safeDiv division.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a of safeAdd carries no standalone semantics and should be folded into the safeAdd function node.
Parameter b of safeAdd carries no standalone semantics and should be folded into the safeAdd function node.
Local return variable c of safeAdd should be absorbed into the safeAdd function node.
Parameter a of safeSub should be folded into the safeSub function node.
Parameter b of safeSub should be folded into the safeSub function node.
Parameter a of safeMul should be folded into the safeMul function node.
Parameter b of safeMul should be folded into the safeMul function node.
Parameter a of safeDiv should be folded into the safeDiv function node.
Parameter b of safeDiv should be folded into the safeDiv function node.
_newOwner parameter is exclusively used to set newOwner inside transferOwnership.
tokenOwner parameter only indexes the balances mapping inside balanceOf.
to parameter is only consumed as the recipient index inside transfer.
tokens parameter is only consumed as the transfer amount inside transfer.
spender parameter only indexes the allowed mapping inside approve.
tokens parameter is only the stored allowance amount inside approve.
from parameter is only used as a balance/allowance key inside transferFrom.
to parameter is only used as the recipient key inside transferFrom.
tokens parameter is only the moved amount inside transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter only serves as the outer key of the allowance lookup.
spender parameter only serves as the inner key of the allowance lookup.
spender parameter drives both the allowance write and the external receiveApproval call in approveAndCall.
tokens parameter is only the approved and forwarded amount in approveAndCall.
data parameter is only forwarded into the untrusted receiveApproval call from approveAndCall.
tokenAddress parameter is only used to select the external token contract in transferAnyERC20Token.
tokens parameter is only the forwarded amount in transferAnyERC20Token.
